strings.name: Mark Carney
strings.role: Politician · Canadian prime minister · Former central banker
strings.summary: Born in the Northwest Territories, Carney studied economics at Harvard and Oxford and worked in finance before public service. He led the Bank of Canada during the 2008 crisis and the Bank of England from 2013, addressing stability and Brexit-era policy. He moved into UN climate finance in 2020, becoming Liberal leader, prime minister and an elected MP in 2025.

strings.influence.rationale: Led the Canadian and British central banks, then entered Canadian national politics, with broad influence in financial stability and climate finance.
